method.dataset: SHAKE256 v1 deterministic payload; 16 distinct 1024-byte docs, one empty file, empty/deep dirs
method.elapsed: perf_counter around /usr/bin/time plus CLI process; includes launch overhead
method.cpu: native time user/system seconds; macOS printed precision 0.01 seconds
method.memory: native time per-command peak RSS normalized to bytes; excludes generator Python process and filesystem cache
method.growth: chunk object count and logical payload bytes; excludes metadata, directory/inode and physical allocation overhead
method.cache: warm/uncontrolled; data generated and SHA-256 validated before timing; no cache drop
method.limitations: small local serial runs; no competing-tool comparison or power-loss tests; sync/cache/system load affect results
